name: @phi-code-admin/phi-code
description: Coding agent CLI with persistent memory, sub-agents, intelligent routing, and orchestration

scripts.build: tsgo -p tsconfig.build.json && shx chmod +x dist/cli.js dist/rpc-entry.js && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: npm --prefix ../tui run build && npm --prefix ../telemetry run build && npm --prefix ../ai run build && npm --prefix ../agent run build && npm --prefix ../protocol run build && npm --prefix ../client run build && npm run build && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-bunfig ./dist/bun/cli.js ./src/utils/image-resize-worker.ts --outfile dist/phi && npm run copy-binary-assets
scripts.copy-assets: shx mkdir -p dist/modes/interactive/theme dist/modes/interactive/assets dist/core/export-html/vendor dist/core && shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/modes/interactive/theme/ && shx cp src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png dist/modes/interactive/assets/ && shx cp src/core/default-models.json dist/core/ && shx cp src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/core/export-html/ && shx cp src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/core/export-html/vendor/
scripts.copy-binary-assets: shx cp package.json dist/ && shx cp README.md dist/ && shx cp CHANGELOG.md dist/ && shx mkdir -p dist/theme && shx cp src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/assets && shx cp -r src/modes/interactive/assets dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && shx mkdir -p dist/export-html/vendor && shx cp src/core/export-html/template.html dist/export-html/ && shx cp src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/export-html/vendor/ && shx cp -r docs dist/ && shx cp -r examples dist/ && shx cp ../../node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm dist/
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build

author: Mario Zechner
